# Special Words Definition

## Batting Average
- Batting average is a measure of a batsman's performance, calculated by dividing the total number of runs scored by the number of times they have been dismissed. A higher batting average indicates a more consistent and successful batsman.
- Batting Average = Total Runs ÷ Total Dismissals

## Strike Rate
- In batting, strike rate indicates the scoring rate of a batsman, showing the average number of runs scored per 100 balls faced. A higher strike rate reflects an aggressive and fast-scoring batsman.
- Strike Rate = (Total Runs ÷ Balls Faced) × 100

## Wickets Taken
- Wickets taken refers to the total number of times a bowler has successfully dismissed an opposing batsman. This statistic is a core measure of a bowler's effectiveness and impact on the game.

## Economy Rate
- Economy rate measures a bowler's efficiency by indicating the average number of runs conceded per over (6 balls) bowled. A lower economy rate shows greater control and efficiency in restricting the opposition's scoring.
- Economy Rate = (Total Runs Conceded ÷ Balls Bowled) × 6

## Wickets Taken
- The number of times a bowler successfully dismisses a batsman in a single match.  This metric is a direct indicator of the bowler's effectiveness, showing how many players they were able to remove from play.

## Runs Given
- The total number of runs scored by the batting side off a particular bowler’s deliveries in a single match.  This value reflects the runs the bowler has conceded to the batting team, and a lower runs-given value is typically favorable for the bowler's performance.

           COALESCE(SUM(bs.runs_scored), 0) + COALESCE(SUM(er.extra_runs), 0) as runs_conceded
    FROM ball_by_ball bbb
    LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs ON bbb.match_id = bs.match_id AND bbb.over_id = bs.over_id AND bbb.ball_id = bs.ball_id AND bbb.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    LEFT JOIN extra_runs er ON bbb.match_id = er.match_id AND bbb.over_id = er.over_id AND bbb.ball_id = er.ball_id AND bbb.innings_no = er.innings_no
    WHERE bbb.bowler IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY bbb.bowler, bbb.match_id
),
bowling_per_match AS (
    SELECT bbb.bowler as player_id, bbb.match_id, COUNT(*) as wickets
    FROM ball_by_ball bbb
    WHERE bbb.bowler IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY bbb.bowler, bbb.match_id
),
best_bowling AS (
    SELECT bpm.player_id, 
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY bpm.player_id ORDER BY bpm.wickets DESC, brpm.runs_conceded ASC) as rn,
           bpm.wickets,
           brpm.runs_conceded
    FROM bowling_per_match bpm
    JOIN bowler_runs_per_match brpm ON bpm.player_id = brpm.player_id AND bpm.match_id = brpm.match_id
),
best_bowling_perf AS (
    SELECT player_id, wickets || '-' || runs_conceded as best_bowling
    FROM best_bowling
    WHERE rn = 1
),
balls_bowled AS (
    SELECT bowler as player_id, COUNT(*) as total_balls_bowled
    FROM ball_by_ball
    WHERE bowler IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY bowler
),
bowler_total_runs AS (
    SELECT bbb.bowler as player_id,
           COALESCE(SUM(bs.runs_scored), 0) + COALESCE(SUM(er.extra_runs), 0) as total_runs_conceded
    FROM ball_by_ball bbb
    LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs ON bbb.match_id = bs.match_id AND bbb.over_id = bs.over_id AND bbb.ball_id = bs.ball_id AND bbb.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    LEFT JOIN extra_runs er ON bbb.match_id = er.match_id AND bbb.over_id = er.over_id AND bbb.ball_id = er.ball_id AND bbb.innings_no = er.innings_no
    WHERE bbb.bowler IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY bbb.bowler
)
SELECT 
    p.player_id,
    p.player_name,
    pr.most_frequent_role,
    p.batting_hand,
    p.bowling_skill,
    COALESCE(pruns.total_runs, 0) as total_runs,
    pm.total_matches,
    COALESCE(pdis.total_dismissals, 0) as total_dismissals,
    CASE WHEN COALESCE(pdis.total_dismissals, 0) > 0 THEN ROUND(1.0 * pruns.total_runs / pdis.total_dismissals, 2) ELSE 0 END as batting_average,
    hs.highest_score,
    COALESCE(th.matches_30, 0) as matches_30,
    COALESCE(th.matches_50, 0) as matches_50,
    COALESCE(th.matches_100, 0) as matches_100,
    COALESCE(bf.total_balls, 0) as total_balls_faced,
    CASE WHEN COALESCE(bf.total_balls, 0) > 0 THEN ROUND(1.0 * pruns.total_runs / bf.total_balls * 100, 2) ELSE 0 END as strike_rate,
    COALESCE(pw.total_wickets, 0) as total_wickets,
    CASE WHEN COALESCE(bb.total_balls_bowled, 0) > 0 THEN ROUND(1.0 * btr.total_runs_conceded / bb.total_balls_bowled * 6, 2) ELSE 0 END as economy_rate,
    bbp.best_bowling
FROM player p
LEFT JOIN player_role pr ON p.player_id = pr.player_id
LEFT JOIN player_runs pruns ON p.player_id = pruns.player_id
LEFT JOIN player_matches pm ON p.player_id = pm.player_id
LEFT JOIN player_dismissals pdis ON p.player_id = pdis.player_id
LEFT JOIN highest_score hs ON p.player_id = hs.player_id
LEFT JOIN thresholds th ON p.player_id = th.player_id
LEFT JOIN balls_faced bf ON p.player_id = bf.player_id
LEFT JOIN player_wickets pw ON p.player_id = pw.player_id
LEFT JOIN balls_bowled bb ON p.player_id = bb.player_id
LEFT JOIN bowler_total_runs btr ON p.player_id = btr.player_id
LEFT JOIN best_bowling_perf bbp ON p.player_id = bbp.player_id
ORDER BY p.player_id
LIMIT 10
